preconditions.expression: len(stdin.strip()) > 0 and all(c in {'A', 'B', 'C', '.'} for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: Input is a non-empty string composed only of 'A', 'B', 'C', or '.' characters.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'Yes' or 'No' (case-insensitive) indicating whether it's possible for at least one cell to contain all three colors after some flowers wither.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'Yes' or stdout.strip() == 'yes' or stdout.strip() == 'YES') == any(all(c in {'A', 'B', 'C'} for c in {s[i], s[i-1], s[i+1]} if 0 <= i-1 < len(s) and 0 <= i+1 < len(s) and s[i] in {'A', 'B', 'C'} and s[i-1] in {'A', 'B', 'C'} and s[i+1] in {'A', 'B', 'C'}) or (s[i] in {'A', 'B', 'C'} and s[i-1] in {'A', 'B', 'C'} and s[i+1] == '.') or (s[i] in {'A', 'B', 'C'} and s[i-1] == '.' and s[i+1] in {'A', 'B', 'C'}) for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if and only if there exists a cell (or combination of cells) where all three colors ('A', 'B', 'C') can appear together after some flowers wither and spread petals to neighboring cells.
